source_class: user physical measurements of visible-LCD offsets from front-glass edges plus direct visible-height remeasurement
interpretation: At least one of T, B or the direct visible-height readings was taken to a different visual boundary or with insufficient precision. No averaging, centering or forced correction is allowed.
required_recheck: Re-measure T and B with the same exact visible-pixel/window boundary used for the visible-height measurement, preferably with calipers.

Alternatively measure the absolute Y coordinate of the visible-window top edge and bottom edge from the same top glass edge; their difference directly gives visible height and avoids adding three separate measurements.
Vertical production datum closes only when T + visible_height + B equals 75.00 mm within the selected measurement tolerance.
do_not_infer: Do not average the 66 mm and 67 mm visible-height readings.
Do not change T=3 mm or B=7 mm merely to force arithmetic closure.
Do not use a production bezel opening that could crop the active image until the vertical datum is reconciled.
